description: Gold Template v1.2 - rectangle-family eyewear frame, scale-corrected (140mm frame width, no authoritative source dimension existed - see metadata/scale_config.json), harmonic (Laplace-equation) lens/rim/bridge coupling, boundary-to-boundary + self-intersection tested. Built and validated across a separate engineering session - see basis_metadata.json changelog for full derivation.

Frame.description: Main eyeglass frame (single connected mesh; also contains the Bridge/LeftRim/RightRim regions - see region_masks below, these are NOT separate GLB meshes in this template)

Rim_L.description: Left rim - a REGION within the Frame mesh (harmonic-solve anchor region), not a separate GLB mesh. vertex_count is the count of Frame vertices in this region.

Rim_R.description: Right rim - region within Frame, see Rim_L note.

Bridge.description: Bridge - region within Frame near LM_BridgeCenter, see Rim_L note.

Temple_L.description: Left temple arm (GLB mesh name: LeftTemple)

Temple_R.description: Right temple arm (GLB mesh name: RightTemple)

author: Claude (engineering session) - geometry sourced from Milan's Rhino model
notes: REAL populated template (not a placeholder) - Gold_Template.zip contents extracted here. See metadata/basis_metadata.json and README below for the full validation trail: scale correction, harmonic lens/rim/bridge coupling, boundary-to-boundary and self-intersection testing.
